decision: Footage = Dropbox 'MR2 SW20 scanning' (20 iPhone clips Jul 20 2026 + Artec Studio screen recording Jul 29); 'MR2 Kalvin footage' not used
why: Kalvin folder is 2025-06 Sony FX30 footage listed under the MR2 Spyder in knowledge/car-inventory.md - a different car and date

decision: Scans = Cage folder 'Full Chassis Interior' + 'Full Chassis T-Top Off' (both exported 2026-07-26); 'Chassis Simplified' (2026-11-10 cabin cut) and the 2025-02 full car not used
why: User: use the scans captured on the footage's date for the 1:1 cut; Simplified is a later design derivative, 2025 car is a different state (pre-strip)

decision: Levelled with huracan level.py then tools/relevel.py (refit ground below z=-250 mm); length check 4,170 mm on the body
why: level.py's RANSAC locked onto the cabin floor because the car is on stands; real ground is ~350 mm lower. 4,170 mm matches the SW20 spec length

decision: 4 mm decimation + numpy island removal (tools/islands.py) instead of prep --drop-islands
why: Blender prep OOM-killed (15 GB) on the 8.2M-tri 3 mm mesh with island removal

decision: States: Interior = doors + T-tops on, trunk open, engine lid open; T-Top Off = doors + both T-tops removed. Parts = Interior minus T-Top Off (tools/diffparts.py): door+T-top per side, interior pieces
why: Both states share the Artec frame; the diff gives the exact panels the crew removed

decision: Rear 1:1 cut: v_1602_50 (scanning the open trunk) -> Interior scan
why: Interior scan has the trunk open with the prop rod on the same diagonal as the footage; T-Top Off scan has the trunk shut and the engine lid open instead (would not match)

decision: Music: parent-supplied SW20 track, start at 5.428 s (first kick 2 accents before the drop); drop = 8.643 s audio = 3.215 s video; kick grid 111.99 BPM fit on kick peaks (40-120 Hz), accents on alternate beats from the drop
why: lessons: anchor on kick peaks, start 2 kicks before the drop on a real hit, put the transformation ON the drop; the 6.9-8.0 s break has no hits

decision: Second 1:1 cut: v_1433_07 @ 2.300 s (crew leaning into the empty left door opening) -> composite 'T-Top Off + both T-tops' (cam_side, 6 pts: fuel-door corners, side-intake louvers, quarter-window corner; fixed 28 mm, RMSE 8.2 px)
why: Footage at 14:33 shows doors off + T-tops on + engine lid open - no single scan has that state, so the T-tops (Interior minus T-Top Off, split from the doors) are added back onto T-Top Off. Onion aligns quarter window, louvers, fuel door, rear arch, sill and door aperture; frunk lid angle differs (lids are not rigid between sessions) and was excluded

decision: Rejected second-cut candidates: v_1447_56 / v_1448_05 (cabin) and v_1529_27 (over the roof)
why: Cabin views are inside a closed scan (sprayed glass + doors) and mixed door states; v_1529_27 is a near-planar cabin view where hand landmarks were ambiguous and an edge-chamfer fit fell into a wrong minimum (looked at the engine bay). Exterior side frame has unambiguous rigid features

decision: Doors: only the INNER face was scanned (outer view shows the same inner panel mirrored); T-top undersides not verifiable. No 'inside + outside' claim; doors spin 180 deg to show their scanned inner panel
why: lessons: render the part from the hidden side and look before claiming inside+outside

decision: End card = illumaesthetic.com/products/toyota-mr2-sw20-3d-scan-1989-1999 (found via Playwright search 'mr2'), no angle-matched morph
why: Listing hero is the 2025 full car with wheels and aftermarket bumper (a different scan/state from the July chassis), so a matched-angle dissolve would not read as the same object

decision: Timeline: IRL rear 3.20 > scan rear 3.23 > IRL scanner screen 1.07 > IRL door panel 1.07 > IRL side 2.13 > scan side (T-tops off) 3.23 > Artec screen rec 1.07 > parts explode 4.30 > x-ray reassembly 4.27 (+0.5 dissolve) > website 5.73; cuts at frames 96/193/225/257/321/418/450/579/707, end 879
why: Cuts on the strong-kick accents (every other beat from the drop) with varied holds of 1/2/3/4 accents as the 240SX lesson asks; ends where the track's music ends (34.7 s audio)

decision: Both 1:1 cuts cut on the solved frame itself (rear 4.400 s, side 2.300 s), so no phaseCorrelate drift shift was needed
why: The real action (crew scanning) plays up to the solved frame in both clips; drift compensation is only needed when the cut is later than the solved frame

decision: Screen recording used as a 1-accent beat between the 1:1 side scan and the exploded parts, cropped 394x700 inside the Artec viewport, 63.5-65.6 s at 2x
why: User suggested it as the beat between real footage and render; the full frame shows personal browser tabs and a remote-desktop window, so only the 3D viewport is shown

decision: Scan shots rendered through tools/render_plus.py (wrapper: extra lights + IVE_END_CAM start->end camera slerp); 75% res, 12 spp, 15 fps, minterpolate to 30
why: Shared blender/ code is out of scope (work only in the project dir); start->end camera lets the matched pose ease into a reveal (orbit + pull + rise in one move)

decision: Parts beat: doors slide out 1.0 m (+0.15 up) and T-tops rise 0.7 m, left parts spin -360 deg and right parts +360 deg about Z; x-ray shot translates them home with no rotation
why: User: parts explode out and rotate left/right; full turns end in the original orientation so the x-ray reassembly is translate-only and continuous with the silver shot

decision: HUD (scan shots only): S1 'TRIANGLES CAPTURED 34,993,395' (Interior STL header); S2 'T-TOPS OFF / 34,998,108 TRIANGLES' (T-Top Off STL header); S3 'DOORS OFF / INNER DOOR PANELS SCANNED'; none on x-ray
why: Only numbers from the files; inner door panels verified by render, outer skins not scanned so not claimed; listing's '0.4 mm accuracy' is website copy, not file data, so not used

decision: First clip shortened to 95 frames (in 1.2667), website +1 frame
